newsitem.title: USA: St. Joseph Light unit acquires bag company.
newsitem.headline: St. Joseph Light unit acquires bag company.

text.p: SJLP Inc, a unit of St. Joseph Light & Power Co, said Friday it has entered an agreement to acquire 51 percent of Percy Kent Bag Co Inc, a maker of shipping sacks and bags.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Kansas City, Mo.,-based Percy Kent has sales offices in Kansas City, Dallas, Minneapolis and Chicago. Production takes place at the company's manufacturing facility in Kansas City.

"We're very pleased to join forces with Percy Kent, which has established itself as a strong competitor in this industry over the last several decades," said Larry Stoll, president of SJLP Inc. "We look forward to working with the company as it seeks continued growth."

SJLP Inc was formed to enhance shareholder value by providing long-term growth opportunities through its role as a value-oriented, opportunistic and active equity investor in non-regulated business sectors, it said.
